description: POST JSON to a webhook SAVED in this workspace (n8n, Make, Zapier or the user's own system), once, now. It only sends to webhooks saved in Integrações e MCP → API e webhooks: takes the saved webhook's name or id, not a URL; an address that is not saved is refused, and so is one that is not public https. Takes exactly one of: payload (a JSON object), sheetId (optionally with rowIds) to send that sheet's rows, or campaignId to send that campaign's people; a sheet or a campaign sends at most 500 rows. The receiver gets {id, type: "send_to_webhook", createdAt, workspaceId, data}, signed like the workspace's event webhooks (X-Nock-Signature). Returns the HTTP status and the start of the response. Data leaves Nock to that receiver. Free.

payload.description: A JSON object to send as `data`. Omit when sending a sheet or a campaign.

rowIds.description: With sheetId: only these rows. Omit for the whole sheet.

sheetId.description: Send this sheet's rows, each as {rowId, <column label>: value}.

webhook.description: The saved webhook's name or id, as listed in Integrações e MCP → API e webhooks.

name: send_to_webhook
title: Enviar para webhook salvo
